headline: Meta launches Meta Enterprise Platform, names ex-MongoDB CEO CJ Desai to lead new AI business unit

supports: Meta launched the Meta Enterprise Platform on September 28, 2026, a new business division bringing Meta's AI technology stack to enterprise customers.
Chirantan 'CJ' Desai, former CEO and President of MongoDB, joined Meta as Chief Enterprise Platform Officer, reporting directly to Mark Zuckerberg, to lead the new division.

claim_checks.claim: Meta launched the Meta Enterprise Platform on September 28, 2026, a new business division bringing Meta's AI technology stack (including the Muse assistant, Meta Business Agent, Muse API, and Muse Code) to enterprise customers.
Meta named Chirantan 'CJ' Desai, former CEO and President of MongoDB, as Chief Enterprise Platform Officer to lead the new division, reporting directly to Mark Zuckerberg.

caption:
🇺🇸 Meta unveiled the Meta Enterprise Platform on Sept. 28, calling it a new pillar of its business that will bring its AI stack — including the Muse assistant, Meta Business Agent, Muse API and Muse Code — to enterprise customers. Chirantan "CJ" Desai, MongoDB's former CEO and president, joins as Chief Enterprise Platform Officer, reporting directly to Mark Zuckerberg. Shares of several enterprise-software companies fell the same day on competitive concerns.

🇪🇸 Meta presentó el 28 de septiembre la Meta Enterprise Platform, a la que calificó como un nuevo pilar de su negocio que llevará su conjunto de herramientas de IA —incluyendo el asistente Muse, Meta Business Agent, Muse API y Muse Code— a clientes empresariales. Chirantan "CJ" Desai, expresidente y CEO de MongoDB, se incorpora como Chief Enterprise Platform Officer y reportará directamente a Mark Zuckerberg. Ese mismo día cayeron las acciones de varias empresas de software empresarial por temor a la competencia.

Sources: Meta Newsroom / TechCrunch — Sept. 28, 2026.
